proposals.evidence: DEDR2783 gives Gondi sēlāṛ sister as well as younger sister. Survey seylal elicited as older sister is a use of the general sister noun; the source age gloss is preserved, without asserting that the stem itself encodes older. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
